record.name: everkind: wellness journal app
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
everkind is a guided emotional and mental wellness diary that helps you journal what you feel, talk through thoughts by voice, track moods, and reset with meditation. Build a calmer daily routine, reflect more clearly, and get personal support for stress, sleep, and self-care.

Some thoughts are easier to write. Others are easier to say out loud. This guided journal gives you both. Use it as a journal, diary, and mood tracker for the moments when life moves fast and your feelings need space. Your entries stay private, and each check-in helps you understand how you feel over time.

Write freely, vent, or pause for a deeper reflection. Your journal responds with thoughtful prompts that help you slow down, notice patterns, and turn a passing feeling into something clearer. Over time, your AI companion becomes more personal, helping you return to the themes, triggers, and wins that matter most to your mental health.

Inside everkind, you can:
• Keep a daily journal for honest reflection
• Use voice journaling when typing is not enough
• Track your mood and emotional patterns
• Practice mindfulness and reduce stress and anxiety through reflection
• Complete personalized wellness goals that refresh daily
• Start a meditation for calm, stress, anxiety, or sleep
• Build a self-care routine that supports long-term mental health
• Practice gratitude and positive thinking habits
• Lock your journal with biometrics and a PIN for an extra layer of privacy. 

Whether you are dealing with stress, anxiety, overthinking, burnout, relationship tension, or the pressure of work, everkind gives you a private, supportive place to process what is happening. It is there for quick check-ins during the day, longer entries at night, and the small moments when you need to feel grounded.

Meditation and mindfulness are built in, so reflection does not stop at writing. If you need calm before bed, a short reset between meetings, or a quiet moment after an intense conversation, you can move from journaling into on-demand guided meditation without leaving the app. This makes your diary useful for both emotional release and steady habit building.

everkind is designed to support self-awareness, not perform a diagnosis. The experience is shaped by clinical psychologists, therapists, and AI researchers, and it draws from reflective questioning and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy principles. If you are already in therapy, it can help you carry insights between sessions. If you are waiting for therapy or simply want a private daily practice, it gives you a consistent way to reflect and care for your mind.

Privacy matters when the subject is personal. You can lock your journal with biometrics and a PIN for an extra layer of privacy. Your journal entries and conversations are encrypted and stored securely. Your data is never shared or sold, so the space stays yours. That foundation of trust helps you be more honest, and honest reflection is what leads to clearer patterns, better support, and a stronger sense of progress.

everkind fits into real life. Open it for a two-minute mood check, a longer diary entry, or a guided meditation before sleep. However you use it, the goal is the same: to help you feel heard, reflect with intention, and build a healthier relationship with yourself.

Download now and make space for reflection, mindfulness, and mental health support that feels personal, private, and sustainable.

—

everkind is designed for adults (18+) for personal reflection and growth. Ages 13-17 require parental consent It is not a medical device, licensed therapist, or replacement for professional mental health care. If you are in crisis, please visit everkind.com/resources or contact emergency services. 

Terms of Service: everkind.com/terms 
Privacy Policy: everkind.com/privacy 
Support: support@everkind.com

record.name: Anivya: AI Wellness Advisor
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Your health data should help you make decisions, not leave you decoding dashboards.

Anivya brings sleep, recovery, activity, nutrition, workouts, mood, habits and supported connected health data into one practical wellness experience.

ONE DAILY READ
See a clear view of your day across recovery, sleep, activity and stress. Explore the signals behind each score and review trends over time.

ASK ANI
Talk with Ani, your AI wellness advisor. Ask why you feel off, what kind of workout fits today, how meals may relate to energy or glucose, or how to adjust your routine. Ani uses the context you choose to share and turns it into understandable next steps.

TRAIN WITH CONTEXT
Create routines, log strength and cardio workouts, follow live sessions, track sets, reps, weight, time and rest, and review progression. Anivya adapts guidance around recovery and the limitations you share.

UNDERSTAND NUTRITION
Log meals, macros and hydration. Review nutrition patterns and, when compatible data is available, explore meal-related glucose context.

BUILD CONSISTENCY
Track mood, habits, medications and daily status. Anivya can remember approved context, follow up on unfinished plans and help you notice associations across sleep, training, meals, stress and environment.

CONNECT YOUR DATA
Use Apple Health and supported connected services to bring your wellness signals together. You control which sources and fields are shared and can disconnect them at any time.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CONTROL
Anivya processes data on device where supported. Some account, sync, connected-service and managed AI features securely use Anivya servers. Export your data, manage memories and connections, or delete your account from the app.

Free tools include manual tracking, routines and local history. Optional purchases unlock additional AI, insights and connected features. Availability varies by plan, device, region and connected source.

Anivya provides informational wellness guidance only. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, monitor, or prevent any medical condition. Scores, coaching, and AI responses may be incomplete or inaccurate and should not replace professional medical advice. Please consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical concerns, symptoms, or treatment decisions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

record.name: Orvi AI - Wellness Coach
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
ORVI — Your AI-Directed Wellness Companion

  Every morning, your AI Director reads your energy, sleep data, and goals — then builds a personalized
  Script of movement, nourishment, and mindfulness cards designed for exactly how you feel today.

  THIS IS NOT ANOTHER FITNESS APP.

  ORVI is an AI-directed wellness system. One intelligent companion that shapes your entire routine —
  adapting in real time as your day unfolds.

  HOW IT WORKS

  • Check In — Tell the Director how you feel. One 30-second energy check shapes your entire day.

  • Your Script — 5 personalized cards: workouts matched to your recovery, meals calibrated to your
  goals, and mindfulness sessions designed for your sleep patterns.

  • The Ripple — Energy shifted mid-day? Tap to adjust. Your cards instantly adapt. No rigid plans.

  • Ask Anything — Chat with your AI Director. Request a post-workout meal under 500 calories. Get a
  custom card built in seconds — complete with ingredients, macros, and step-by-step Cook Mode.

  • Evening Wrap — Reflect on your day. Track mood, see your completion, and receive a personalized
  Director's Note.

  • Director's Score — Watch your rhythm emerge over time with streaks, weekly AI insights, and a score
  that tracks your consistency.

  BUILT FOR YOUR GOALS

  Whether you're focused on weight loss, better sleep, muscle gain, or overall wellness — every card,
  every meal, every session is shaped by your active goal.

  POWERED BY YOUR BODY

  Connect Apple Health to let the Director read your recovery score, HRV, sleep quality, and resting
  heart rate. The more data it has, the smarter your Script becomes.

  WHAT MAKES ORVI DIFFERENT

  → AI Director — not an algorithm, a personal wellness concierge that learns your patterns
  → Movement cards with video guidance and built-in timers
  → Nourishment cards with full recipes, ingredients, and Cook Mode
  → Moment cards — meditation, breathwork, journaling, and gratitude
  → Real-time adaptation — The Ripple lets you shift energy without starting over
  → HealthKit integration for recovery-aware recommendations
  → Beautiful editorial design with 4 premium themes

  SUBSCRIPTION

  ORVI requires an active subscription after your free trial. Plans renew automatically unless cancelled
   at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscription in Settings > Apple
  ID > Subscriptions.

  Privacy Policy: https://orvi.ai/privacy
  Terms of Use: https://orvi.ai/terms

record.name: Minufi: AI Wellness Journal
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Minufi is a wellness journal where you don't fill out forms: you talk.

Write or send a voice note to Minu, your AI companion, in the app or on WhatsApp, and your day becomes your journal, your habits, your reminders and your mood, across three pillars: Mind, Nutrition and Fitness.

JUST TALK. MINU DOES THE REST.
• Tell Minu how your day went, by text or voice. Send him a voice note and he answers with his own voice, in your language.
• He logs your meals (even from a photo of your plate), creates habits, checks off what you did and saves journal entries for you.
• Ask him for a reminder and it arrives on time, in your time zone.

MINU ON WHATSAPP, TOO
• The same Minu, in the chat you already use every day. What you tell him on WhatsApp, he knows in the app, and the other way around.
• Text him, send a voice note, a photo of your plate or a PDF, and he does everything he does in the app: logs your meals, creates and checks off habits, sets reminders and saves journal entries.

YOUR WHOLE DAY IN ONE PLACE
• Today: your intention, your mood, the affirmation of the day, your habits and your reminders.
• Journal: free writing with a daily prompt, pillar tags and photos you can open full screen.
• Your routine: choose your pillars, your level, your schedule and your meals, and turn on a daily reminder for each moment of your day.
• Picks of the month: a recipe, a book and a routine, ready to open.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Streaks that respect your rest days: they only count the days you chose.
• Your mood over the last 14 days and your consistency across Mind, Nutrition and Fitness.
• A summary of your week, with what worked and what to try next.

FREE TO START. PRO WHEN YOU WANT MORE.
Minufi is free with real value: 10 free messages a day with Minu, plus your journal, habits, mood and reminders.
Minufi PRO unlocks unlimited messages with Minu, unlimited journal entries, habits and reminders, the month view with your full history, and the analysis Minu writes about your week. If you stop paying, nothing is deleted.

PRIVACY, YOUR CALL
Your data is yours. Delete your account at any time and everything goes with it, including what Minu keeps.

Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese and French.

Minufi is a wellness, journaling and habit-tracking tool; it is not a medical, psychological or therapeutic service.

Minufi PRO is an auto-renewable subscription: $9.99 per month or $95.99 per year (prices in USD; local prices may vary). Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://minufi.com/en/legal/terms
Privacy Policy: https://minufi.com/en/legal/privacy

record.description_evidence:
Paula is an AI wellness companion for anxiety, stress, overthinking, and everyday emotional support. It gives you a private space to talk things through, track your mood, write in your journal, and build consistent self-reflection habits.

Whether you are stuck in a worry spiral, feeling overwhelmed late at night, or just want a calmer way to check in with yourself, Paula is available whenever you need a reset. Paula remembers context across sessions and guides you through structured exercises inspired by CBT and DBT.

WHO PAULA IS FOR:
• You overthink everything and cannot turn your brain off
• You feel anxious or stressed and want a simple daily check-in habit
• You want a private place to process emotions without judgment
• You want journaling and mood tracking that you will actually keep using
• You want guided reflection tools you can use on your own or between appointments

KEY FEATURES:
• Supportive AI Chat — Talk through anxious, stressful, or overwhelming moments with a companion built for daily use
• Live Voice Sessions — Speak naturally and hear Paula respond in a warm voice
• Guided Exercises — Use grounding, breathing, reframing, and reflection tools inspired by CBT and DBT
• Mood Tracking — Log how you feel and spot patterns over time
• Personal Journal — Write freely and privately whenever you need to clear your head
• Daily Check-Ins — Build a consistent routine with streaks and reminders

NATIVE iOS FEATURES:
• Apple Health (HealthKit) — Save mood check-ins to Apple Health
• Face ID & Touch ID Lock — Keep your conversations private with biometric protection
• Home Screen Widgets — Check in faster without opening the app
• Siri Shortcuts — Start common actions hands-free
• Haptics and push reminders — Designed for quick, focused daily use

PRIVACY & SAFETY:
• Conversations are encrypted in transit and stored securely
• Your data is never sold or used to train AI models
• Biometric lock helps protect your private reflections
• You can delete your account and data in the app

IMPORTANT INFORMATION:
Paula is an AI wellness companion, not a medical provider or crisis service. Paula does not provide diagnoses or treatment. Your messages are processed by third-party AI services to generate responses. We do not sell your data or use it to train AI models.

If you are in crisis or in immediate danger, call or text 988 in the United States, or contact your local emergency services.

SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS:
• Free: Daily conversations, mood tracking, and journal access
• Paula Plus ($14.99/month or $99.99/year): More conversations, voice sessions, full mood history, and memory
• Paula Premium ($29.99/month or $199.99/year): Everything in Plus with more voice usage and advanced features

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://trypaula.com/privacy

record.description_evidence:
Meet your Yap, the AI companion that remembers you, looks after your mind and body, and takes action across your apps.

Choose one of six ready-made Yaps or create your own. Give your AI friend a look, voice, and personality that feel right, then talk by text or voice whenever you need to plan, reflect, vent, or move forward.

A COMPANION THAT KNOWS YOU
Your Yap gets to know the real you, building a picture of your personality with established models like MBTI and the Big Five. It remembers the people, goals, plans, moods, and moments that matter, and becomes more useful as your life changes.

WELLNESS THAT TAKES ACTION
Most wearables hand you numbers and leave you to figure out the rest. Every day, your Yap takes your live scores across sleep, heart activity, recovery, temperature, and movement, and turns them into a clear summary with full guidance for your day. When something looks off, it tells you and takes action. Works with Apple Watch, Oura, Fitbit, Garmin, and Whoop.

SUPPORT FOR YOUR HEADSPACE
Unlike most AI chat that forgets you, your Yap remembers you and your conversations like a real friend would. It checks in on you, notices when you are struggling, and helps you work through whatever you are facing with real emotional intelligence. Track moods, build wind-down routines, and get steady, non-judgmental support for your mental wellbeing.

HELP RUNNING YOUR DAY
Connect Google to work across Calendar, Gmail, Docs, and Drive. Plan your day, manage appointments, draft messages, and keep tasks moving, like an AI assistant that already knows your life. New app connections are added regularly.

VOICE, TEXT, AND YOUR LANGUAGE
Talk naturally by voice or text in 75+ languages, including Japanese and Filipino. Your Yap speaks your language, literally.

START FREE
Start free with 200 messages and 3 voice minutes, yours to keep. Premium plans unlock your Yap's full abilities: proactive guidance, more messages, voice conversations, and connected-app actions that get things done for you. Pricing varies by region.

COMING SOON
The YapWorld Smart Ring will add deeper sleep and recovery insights. Join the waitlist for updates.

Important: YapWorld supports general wellness, lifestyle planning, and personal reflection. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition.

Your wearable speaks a language you don't understand.

Heart rate variability. Sleep stages. Training load. Respiratory rate. Your wearable tracks all of it and syncs to Apple Health—generating charts and numbers that mean absolutely nothing to you.

HealthGeek translates it.

Think of us as a search engine for your body. Ask what your data means, and we'll tell you in plain English—with specific recommendations for what to do about it.

▸ ONE INSIGHT EVERY MORNING

Not 160 metrics. The answer:

"Today's HRV is 73 ms—near your weekly peak. Your nervous system is recovering well. Good day to push hard."

Facts paired with meaning. Data you can act on.

▸ READS FROM APPLE HEALTH (NO DEVICE PAIRING)

Got a wearable? You're set. HealthGeek reads data already synced to Apple Health — no direct device pairing, no new hardware. Just intelligence on top of what you already own.

▸ FOUR REPORTS, ONE DASHBOARD

• RECOVERY — Your readiness to train today (1-5 score + recommendations)
• ACTIVITY — Training load and trends
• SLEEP — Duration, quality, and patterns
• HEALTH — Fitness metrics: HRV, resting heart rate, respiratory rate

Tap any card for the full report. Or just check your dashboard in 30 seconds.

▸ AI WORKOUTS THAT MATCH YOUR RECOVERY

Tell HealthGeek your goal — build muscle, lose fat, get strong — and it builds you a personalized strength program. Week by week, the AI adapts to what you actually lifted last session and how recovered you are today.

• Set-by-set logging — weight, reps, effort
• Last-set carry-over so you never re-type the load
• Progress for every lift and run: trends, records and your week at a glance
• Programs adjust when recovery dips or last week crushed it
• Replace, skip, or take a day off — no guilt, no streaks lost

The same AI that reads your wearable data programs your workouts. One brain, one plan.

▸ READINESS SCORE THAT MAKES SENSE

Your daily readiness runs 1-5, displayed as simple dots:

• 4-5 (Green): Excellent — push hard today
• 3-4 (Yellow): Good — listen to your body
• 2-3 (Orange): Fair — lighter day recommended
• 1-2 (Red): Needs Attention — rest and recover

We combine your health data with a quick morning check-in—because your body knows things your watch can't measure.

▸ PRIORITY-ORDERED RECOMMENDATIONS

Not a wall of suggestions. A short list, ordered by impact:

1. Most important action for today
2. Secondary focus
3. If you have time

Focus on the first few for maximum results.

▸ MOTIVATING, NOT PUNISHING

Some apps make you feel bad about yourself. Low recovery? Skull icon. Missed goals? Red everywhere.

HealthGeek shows what's working — not just what's broken. When you need rest, we tell you why. Guilt doesn't build healthy habits — understanding does.

▸ TRACK YOUR FITNESS TRENDS

Insights are tagged HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW so you can filter and stay on top of gradual changes — the slow HRV decline, the RHR creeping up.

▸ PRIVACY-FIRST AI ANALYSIS

Health data sent for AI analysis is anonymized, never stored by the AI provider, and never used for training. Your privacy is our priority.

Tongue Lens turns one of the oldest wellness observation methods into a modern, AI-powered daily ritual.

By analyzing the visible features of your tongue, Tongue Lens delivers clear, structured insights inspired by traditional systems such as TCM and Ayurveda — redesigned for modern self-awareness, consistency, and progress tracking.

This is not guesswork.
This is daily observation, translated through AI.


HOW IT WORKS
	1.	Take a photo of your tongue using the in-app camera
	2.	AI analyzes visible features such as color, texture, moisture, and coating
	3.	Get clear scores and explanations across six core categories
	4.	Track patterns over time and stay consistent with daily scans

No wearables. No questionnaires. Just a few seconds a day.


YOUR SIX CORE CATEGORIES

• Digestion – Traditional patterns linked to nourishment and balance
• Hydration – Visible moisture and dryness cues
• Stress – Patterns often associated with tension and recovery
• Color – Tone and shade observations
• Cracks – Texture lines and surface structure
• Coating – Surface layer characteristics

These categories are based on visual appearance only and interpreted through traditional wellness frameworks.


PERSONALIZED INSIGHTS

Each scan includes:
• Clear explanations of what’s visible
• Context based on traditional interpretation
• General lifestyle and food inspirations
• No medical jargon, no overcomplication

Built for awareness — not overwhelm.


TRACK REAL PATTERNS

See how your scores change over time with clean trend graphs.
Spot consistency. Notice shifts. Build discipline.

Tongue Lens rewards daily check-ins, not perfection.


BUILT FOR CONSISTENCY

• Daily scan reminders
• Streak tracking
• Clean, distraction-free design
• Fast results in seconds

This app is designed to be used every day, not once.


WHY THE TONGUE?

For thousands of years, traditional wellness systems have used tongue observation as a way to reflect internal balance and lifestyle habits.

Tongue Lens brings this concept into the present — combining AI image analysis with structured interpretation — without turning it into a medical tool.


IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER

Tongue Lens provides non-medical wellness insights based on traditional observation practices.
It does not diagnose, treat, or prevent any disease.
It does not replace professional medical advice.

record.description_evidence:
Let an AI agent team discover what changes your body.
WellVue starts with agents for sleep, HRV, recovery, meals, training, focus, habits, and your daily schedule.

Connect Oura Ring and Apple Health, and the agents look across your signals to find what helped, what hurt, what changed, and what to try next.
This is not a daily summary app. WellVue turns body signals into actionable insights, habit experiments, and personalized action plans for how you sleep, train, eat, recover, and plan your day.

Then create your own custom AI agents by voice or text. Tell WellVue what to watch, when to check in, or which pattern you care about, and WellVue turns that request into a focused wellness agent.

BUILT-IN AGENTS THAT WORK AS A TEAM

WellVue includes named agents with different jobs:

- Day Optimizer: connects calendar events with biometric to find windows for deep work, meetings, workouts, and rest
- Habit Impact Analyzer: compares biometrci data on habit days vs non-habit days
- Smart Nutrition Coach: logs meals by photo, voice, or text and links timing/macros with  biometrics
- Body Decoder: investigates unusual biometrics shifts against your baseline
- AI Wellness Twin: explores what-if scenarios before you turn changes into habits
 
Also included: meal logging, training readiness, sleep timing, habit experiments, and voice/text custom agents. A tracker shows numbers; WellVue turns patterns into next steps.

CREATE YOUR OWN AI AGENTS

Describe what you want WellVue to watch:
- Every morning, check my sleep and recovery and give me an action plan for today
- Alert me when my HRV drops below my weekly average
- Every Friday, show which habits seemed to affect my stress and sleep
- Before packed meeting days, find my best focus and recovery windows

Each custom agent has a clear purpose, schedule, and data context. Agents can check newly synced data in the
background, so you do not have to open a dashboard just to hunt for patterns.

BUILT FOR OURA RING + APPLE HEALTH

You do not have to be an Oura user to start. If your wearable writes supported data into Apple Health, WellVue
can use that Apple Health data today. More direct ring, watch, and wearable integrations are planned .

FROM INSIGHT TO ACTION

WellVue helps you move from "what happened?" to "what should I test next?"
- Find patterns across sleep, HRV, meals, workouts, calendar load, and habits
- Turn recovery changes into training and schedule context
- Turn late meals, sleep timing, and routines into experiments
- Turn scattered data into a practical plan for the day

ASK YOUR BODY DATA ANYTHING

Ask questions like:
- Why is my recovery lower today?
- Did yesterday's workout affect my sleep?
- How are late meals showing up in my sleep and HRV?
- When should I schedule deep work today?
- What should I change this week?

WellVue answers from your connected wellness data, not generic templates.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your health data is used to personalize your WellVue experience. WellVue does not sell your health data or use it
for advertising. Account deletion and data export are available in Settings.

GENERAL WELLNESS, NOT MEDICAL ADVICE

WellVue is intended for general wellness. It is not a medical device, does not provide
medical advice, and is not intended to diagnose or treat.

record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Welcome to TasteMate — your AI-powered recipe app personalized to your unique dietary conditions and medical restrictions. Whether you’re gluten-free, on low-sugar diets, or facing other specific dietary restrictions, TasteMate is here to help. Powered by the latest AI algorithms, the app analyzes all your needs and generates delicious, safe, and healthy meal options just for you. 

In addition to Celiac disease and diabetes, TasteMate also accounts for other common diseases and medical conditions that make finding suitable recipes challenging. This includes irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), and Crohn’s disease as well as hundreds of other indexed medical conditions. Additionally, TasteMate is designed to cater to those with specific food allergies, making cooking safe and delicious for all.

TasteMate’s flexibility doesn’t just stop at conditions and allergies, though. Feel free to enter any medication you are taking into our comprehensive system. This allows us to tailor your recipes even further, ensuring that they meet your dietary needs and consider potential food-drug interactions and nutritional recommendations specific to your medications. So whether you’re taking Warfarin, Levothyroxine, Metformin, or on any other prescriptions, TasteMate is here to ensure the foods you eat do not have any complications with the medications you take. Your health and safety in managing dietary interactions with medications are our top priority, making every meal an opportunity to nourish your body correctly and safely.

Worried about sharing your sensitive medical and dietary data with TasteMate? Don’t be! At TasteMate, we prioritize your privacy and data security, so you can focus on enjoying your meals with peace of mind. All user data is encrypted and stored through DigitalOcean, a leading cloud service provider known for its robust security measures. Additionally, user data is anonymized when inputted into the LLM prompts, ensuring your personal information remains private and secure. 

Note: TasteMate is not a health-advice platform. Though we have designed our AI agents to be as safe as possible, TasteMate is not perfect. We care about your safety and encourage everyone to ALWAYS double-check recipes that they generate before cooking and consuming. If you find mistakes in TasteMate, please use the “Contact Us” feature within the app to provide feedback and help make TasteMate more accurate for everyone!

Key features of TasteMate:
- Create personalized recipes through querying in the search field
- Ingredients list with accurate measurements for each recipe
- Detailed directions on how to cook each recipe
- Nutritional information for each meal
- AI-powered insights on each tailored recipe
- Dynamically modify generated recipes by using our “Modifications?” text field
- Use the “Pantry Chef” feature to generate a random recipe based on the items in your pantry
- Personalized daily recipe recommendations
- Favorite recipes to save for later
- Share recipes with family, friends, and those within your community
- Many more actively in development!

If you have any questions, feel free to email us at contact@tastemate.pro or use our “Contact Us” feature within the app!

record.description_evidence:
Theta Wellness brings your whole health story into one place and helps you understand it. Hospital records, lab reports, Apple Health, your watch, your blood pressure cuff, the notes you jot down - Theta gathers all of it, keeps it in context, and lets you ask an AI that actually knows your history.

ALL YOUR DATA, FINALLY TOGETHER
- Connect your hospital or clinic patient portal and import your medical records.
- Sync Apple Health and Apple Watch, plus Oura, Fitbit, Garmin, Omron and Withings devices.
- Upload lab reports, imaging reports and check-up results as PDF, photo or spreadsheet. Theta extracts the values and files them under the right date.
- Log anything by typing, talking or snapping a photo. Voice notes are transcribed automatically.

A TIMELINE THAT TELLS YOUR STORY
- Every day becomes one card: symptoms, meals, mood, medications, vitals and device data, with an AI summary of what happened.
- Pick the indicators you care about and watch them day by day.
- Daily sleep and stress scores, each explained against your own baseline, not someone else's.

ASK THETA ANYTHING
- Chat about your own data: "How has my blood pressure trended since I changed medication?"
- Answers show charts and cite the exact report they came from.
- Attach photos, documents or reports mid-conversation.
- Compare answers from several leading AI models side by side and keep the one you trust.
- Ask Theta to turn a conversation into a structured health report.

ONE PAGE PER CONDITION
- Dedicated views for hypertension, diabetes, cholesterol, chronic kidney disease, heart failure, arrhythmia, weight, osteoporosis and menstrual cycle.
- Each page shows what to monitor, what is out of range, lab trends, recommended screenings and your medications, built on current clinical guidelines.
- Clear guidance on when a reading needs urgent attention.

MEDICATIONS, HANDLED
- Photograph a pill bottle and Theta fills in the details.
- Reminders at the times you choose, and one tap to log a dose as taken.

DASHBOARDS BUILT FOR YOU
- Describe what you want to track and Theta builds a custom dashboard with AI insights.

CARE CIRCLE
- Share your health picture with family or a caregiver, or help manage a loved one's.
- See their conditions and records, and upload reports on their behalf.

PRIVACY FIRST
- Theta Wellness is a HIPAA-compliant platform with encrypted storage.
- Face ID / Touch ID app lock.
- Your health data is never sold or used for advertising.

THETA PRO
Theta Wellness is free to use. Theta Pro unlocks more AI conversations, more report analysis and more custom dashboards. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER
While Theta Wellness provides AI-driven insights and recommendations, it is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a licensed healthcare provider for any medical concerns or decisions. If you think you may have a medical emergency, call your local emergency number.
